q2_gaps: comitative / additive PP whose object is an INANIMATE co-participant undergoing the same action ('burns wintergloss alongside mire-essence', where mire-essence is a second thing burned): CoAgent is defined animate-only and no co-Patient / co-Theme route is given, so the preposition-named oblique is the only licensed carrier and it does not record that mire-essence is burned too
notes: Indefinite singular subject plus bare simple present correctly stays a witness-and-event (not a kind relation, not a generic rule) with no status atom, and the bare mass object/oblique NPs correctly stay constants. Whether a coined substance word like 'wintergloss' is 'transparently modifier + head' enough to license (Inheritance wintergloss gloss) is the one judgment call, and the closed-spelling rule as written favours emitting it.
